independent_roles.remaining_semantic_delta: The source gives one convex-to-linear regret reduction. This unchanged finite-history library realization retains a closed-domain API and properness/global support-availability conditions. Closedness is EXCESS for an unrestricted source Anchor; the broader source interface remains an open obligation. Structural recursion identities and the derived fixed-horizon guarantee schema are not additional numbered source results. This is the unchanged bounded deterministic library refinement of the Section 2.3 convex-to-linear reduction. The inherited closed-domain interface is EXCESS for the unrestricted source Anchor, which remains open. Properness and whole-domain support availability restrict the loss interface; actual played legality suffices for the ambient comparison without learner feasibility. Feasible learner and admissible losses at t<T justify provider adapters and exclude the canonical zero fallback on that prefix. A,p are fixed deterministic functions without external independence or measurable/executable implementation claims. The transferred hB covers every vector sequence and feasible comparator for the same learner at the given T; B may depend on the full sequence and may be negative. Real loss interpretation follows finiteness proofs before toReal. Source1..T is Lean0..T-1; T0 is an empty-sum extension. No numerical rate for arbitrary learners, universal optimality, unrestricted source closure, chapter/book completion, purification or Exposition Seal is asserted.
